task: Check fire extinguisher and service date
steps: Check the pressure gauge - the needle should be in the green zone.
Inspect the pin and tamper seal to confirm it hasn't been used or discharged.
Look for corrosion, dents, or a damaged hose.
Shake dry-chemical extinguishers monthly to prevent the powder from settling/caking.
Replace or professionally service per the tag date, generally every 6-12 years.
